Alger, 11 août 2026 (Algeria Tech) — En: Algiers, August 11, 2026 (Algeria Tech) — This August, the Qoder platform officially launched Qwen3.8-Max, a new version of the Qwen series integrating 2.4 trillion parameters. The event coincides with Qoder's first anniversary, which has recorded over 5 million users since its launch in August 2025.
Nouveau modèle phare et promotions pour: New flagship model and promotions for Qoder's anniversary
La plateforme Qoder officialise le déplo: The Qoder platform is formalizing the deployment of Qwen3.8-Max, the latest addition to the Qwen family, with significant improvements in code processing, office tasks, and deep reasoning. This model, featuring 2.4 trillion parameters, succeeds Qwen3.7-Max and positions itself as a major breakthrough in artificial intelligence capabilities.
Pour célébrer le premier anniversaire de: To celebrate Qoder's first anniversary, two promotions are being offered to users. On the one hand, newly registered users and existing paid subscribers benefit from 800 free calls to Qwen3.8-Max. On the other hand, new subscribers (Pro, Pro+, Ultra, or Personal Resource Pack plans) during the event receive an additional 2,000 calls, which can be combined with the initial 800. A 50% discount is also applied to the model's pricing during off-peak hours.
Les 800 appels gratuits permettent d'exé: The 800 free calls allow for the execution of approximately 80 tasks, while the 2,000 calls allow for about 200. These estimates are based on averages and may vary depending on the complexity of the queries.
L'événement se déroule du 3 août 2026 à: The event runs from August 3, 2026, at 10:00 AM (UTC+8) to September 3, 2026, at 11:59 PM (UTC+8). Claims must strictly be made before this deadline. The benefits are accessible via Qoder Desktop, Qoder JetBrains Plugin, Qoder CLI, QoderWake, Qoder Cloud Agents, or Qoder Mobile/Web App. Only one platform is required to make the claim, but the calls can be used across all connected devices.
Pour activer les appels gratuits, les ut: To activate the free calls, users must update Qoder to the latest version, log into their account, and claim the credits in the "Usage" panel. The 2,000 bonus calls from an order must also be claimed manually in the same section. Once exhausted, the calls are billed according to the credits of the current plan or resource pack.
Les avantages de l'événement ne sont ni: The event benefits are neither transferable nor exchangeable for cash. The promotions apply only to individual plans and solely for the Qwen3.8-Max model. No cancellations or revocations of credits are provided for after they have been claimed.
